briefing: Markets were modestly negative today (NASDAQ -0.7%, S&P 500 -0.6%), a neutral-to-soft session with no major risk-off signal. With 3 open portfolio slots and cash above the $500 deployment threshold, we filled those slots with the highest-scoring, multi-signal-confirmed candidates (HALO, AAPL, ZIM) rather than letting cash sit idle, while holding all existing positions unchanged.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Cash drag happens when uninvested money sits idle in a portfolio instead of earning returns, slowly dragging down overall performance versus a fully invested benchmark like the S&P 500. That's why, once risk rules are satisfied, it's often better to deploy idle cash into your best-scoring candidates rather than let it sit on the sidelines.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「現金拖累」(Cash Drag) 指資金閒置未作投資,未能賺取回報,長遠會拉低整體投資組合表現,跑輸如標普500等完全投資的指數。因此在符合風險管理規則的前提下,將閒置現金配置到評分最高的標的,通常比持有現金觀望更為有利。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted slightly lower today with no single dominant catalyst reported, consistent with a routine consolidation after recent gains. Trading volumes and price moves were modest across both NASDAQ and S&P 500, suggesting profit-taking rather than a shift in broader sentiment. No major negative headlines emerged to justify a defensive posture, so the selloff looks like normal short-term noise.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市輕微回軟，NASDAQ及標普500均錄得溫和跌幅，但未見有重大單一消息主導市場。成交量及波幅均屬正常水平,反映較似獲利回吐而非市場氣氛逆轉。由於沒有重大負面消息支持防守性部署,今次回調較大機會屬短期技術性整理。
